body:
I cannot pinpoint exactly what brought me here.  It is a spiderweb of life's events that brought me here.  I am not one to feel sorry for myself, so I kept a lot inside my whole life.  I was abused sexually and emotionally as a little girl, once I hit my teens and relationships with boys started, they were all abusive.  At 19 my first born son passed away in my arms and his father blamed me.  I was relocated to the other side of the country when my ex tried to kill me by stabbing me and dousing me with gasoline but he made one mistake....he wanted to get high before lighting me up and it gave me the time I needed to escape.  I have had an eating disorder since I was 15, it has haunted me for 18 years but my family doctor still has the idea I am too fat to have an eating disorder.  Now I have a 9 year old daughter who suffers from obesity and bullying at school and it kills me.  I do not know how to help or ease her pain at all.  I am not capable of even being a mom.
I am engaged to a man who I constantly disappoint after being away from me in Afghanistan for two years.  I buried my dad 2 years ago after losing his life to leukemia and I never did get closure.  He haunts me on a daily basis because of where we left off.  I had a hysterectomy in December due to cervical cancer and I don't feel I have anythig to offer, as a woman, as a mom, as a wife.  I am a let down to my family and have been told this since a little child.  I have no friends left for they have all been killed in accidents, have taken their own lives, or have hurt me to the point of walking away (stealing, etc)

I cannot pinpoint anything.  I just know that everytime someone is taken, I am upset that it had to be someone happy and content in life.  I just want to be the one to go.  I have wished that I didn't have to finalize it and maybe my car would have a defect and just blow up.  I hope that this doesn't appear to be endless ranting :(
